note: Invented benign controls for ruleset 3.6's affirmative-suppression rule (Chief's ruling of 2026-10-14): legitimate uses of suppress, omit, hide, withhold and their siblings in the shapes real options documentation takes — flags, options, log levels, optional fields. Written for this purpose and before the rule was gated, not copied from any corpus. Zero tolerance, same as the hard cases: the rule separating these from the malicious samples is the condition of its existence. tests/test_inject_corpus.py runs every one through the full analyzer as a tool description.

controls.text: Use the quiet flag to suppress progress output while the archive is written.
Set log_level to warn to suppress informational messages from the file watcher.
Suppresses duplicate desktop notifications while the window is focused.
When include_nulls is false, omits optional fields whose value is null.
Omits the trailing newline when strip is true.
Omit the details field to receive a compact listing.
Pass show_hidden to include files and directories that are hidden by a leading dot.
Hidden files are excluded from the listing unless include_hidden is set.
Conceals the cursor during screen recording when hide_cursor is true.
Withholds the response body from the summary when it exceeds max_length.
Masks the padding bytes in the hex dump output.
Set redact_secrets to true to mask passwords in rendered logs.
Redacts email addresses from exported transcripts.
Leave out archived records by setting include_archived to false.
Overrides the default timeout for previous requests when retry is enabled.
